Scope: Exact coordinate arithmetic, binary visitor queue order and edge/stop behavior, and QR component bounds, areas and order match independent integer and graph references. The new contracts pass nine cases on .NET 10 and .NET 8 and five on .NET Framework. Native ARM64 passes the same nine coordinate/component cases and 32 public QR, Data Matrix and Aztec decoding cases on the exact managed core and test assembly.
Limits: Image widths, pixel offsets, four-connectivity, candidate limits, queue representation, polarity and cancellation/deadline polling retain their existing domain and behavior. No complete-scan speed, reliable deadline completion, CPU, throughput or memory-capacity guarantee follows from the component-only experiment.
